---
title: "About"
---

**InterACT** is a collaborative workshop between the [interpretable machine learning / explainable AI group][slds-iml] of the chair of statistical learning and data science (SLDS) of [LMU Munich][lmu] and the [Emmy Noether Junior Research Group][emmy] of the Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology - BIPS.

The workshop is aimed primarily at PhD students in the field of interpretable machine learning (IML) and explainable AI (XAI) and includes postdoctoral and senior researchers.

## Past Workshops

InterACT #1 was held November 13th -- 16th 2023 in Munich.  
Among many brainstorming session, it spawned the successfully published "CountARFactuals" project [@dandl2024countarfactuals], bridging counterfactual explanations and tree-based generative modeling.

InterACT #2 was held September 23rd -- 26th 2024 in Bremen and directly supported by the [Minds, Media, Machines Integrated Graduate School (MMMIGS) PhD Grant Bremen][mmmigs].
